purpose: V7 chronological routing scenarios. Executors receive only user_request and raw_inputs; results stay outside this package.

cases.user_request: Prepare a usable cover-direction brief and proposed revised blurb, then tell me what to test now and what should wait. Only front-cover concept and copy planning for The Salt Orchard; no final production. Under 650 words. No image generation, publishing or external research.

raw_inputs.brief.txt: Original standalone fantasy by Mara Venn; possible future series undecided. Keep the established author wordmark, but no series logo or trim size is selected. Preferred palette sea green/chalk; tone tense but warm. No full-book rewrite.
raw_inputs.story-boundaries.txt: Nera promises to guide the last orchard keeper across a flooded causeway before debt collectors arrive. Her silver left eye is first revealed halfway through the story and must not appear in cover or promotional copy. Appearance note: traveling cloak, covered left eye, lantern. Approved portrait reportedly shows both eyes including the silver eye. Actual portrait and wordmark files are not supplied.
raw_inputs.working-copy.txt: Draft blurb: 'Nera has hidden her silver eye for seventeen years. When the collectors reach the Salt Orchard, she promises its last keeper a path across the flooded causeway. The price of that promise may be more than either can carry.' Working copy may be revised. No back/flap allocation or type size is fixed.

observable_behaviors: Produces actual useful brief and revised blurb removing early silver-eye disclosure without inventing major plot outcomes.
Preserves wordmark and distinguishes undecided series/trim from established direction.
Carries reader boundary into art/portrait/copy and leaves unsupplied image suitability unverified.
Interleaves actual copy/type/crop pilot before scaling; does not claim rendered/fit checks on absent assets.
Completes concept/copy scope now while deferring final physical geometry; ISBN/page count do not block the brief.
Discloses supplied notes versus absent files and actual consulted material.

cases.user_request: Give me an edition-by-edition action table and correct next-action order for Lanterns at Low Tide. Explain what the old receipt establishes. Records audit/repair plan only, under 650 words. Do not rebuild, upload or claim inspection of absent files.

raw_inputs.current-record.txt: Paperback went from 280 to 284 pages; latest user-selected interior is now 288. Wrap/template was made for 284-page local interior. Hardcover remains 291 pages; its jacket/template was independently made for that edition. Paper, binding, ISBNs and hashes are absent. These are records, not actual files.
raw_inputs.prior-review.txt: RH-12 reports unchanged hardcover interior/jacket pair passed local rendered check; no new hardcover changes requested. RP-9 reports 284-page paperback proof checked before latest text changes. Neither report supplies hashes. Preserve their actual scopes.
raw_inputs.receipt.txt: Old platform receipt names paperback cover paired with 280-page interior. Exact uploaded files/hashes cannot be recovered from receipt. Receipt only, not current pair validation, proof approval or distribution.
raw_inputs.cover-issue.txt: Current paperback proof note reports last line of approved back copy crosses safe-area boundary. Actual PDF/copy/font/art absent. Preserve approved wording/art if layout can fix fit. No permission to publish or rewrite the book.

observable_behaviors: Produces separate edition actions distinguishing 288 current/284 wrap basis/280 receipt without invented geometry/hashes.
Orders current interior identity/review, applicable template facts, physical cover assembly, exported review/repair, exact-pair handoff correctly.
Retains RH-12 only as historical scoped evidence; checks unchanged identities before relying on it, no automatic hardcover rebuild/fresh pass.
Treats overflow as reported; inspects actual layout and preserves approved wording/art while repairing/rechecking targeted surfaces.
Limits old receipt to historical receipt and unknown exact files, no current pair acceptance/reupload authority.
Useful next actions within records-only endpoint with honest source/review scope.
